business_summary: Nuveen New York AMT-Free Quality Municipal Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments, Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC and Nuveen Asset Management, LLC. It invests in the fixed income markets of New York. The fund invests in undervalued municipal securities and other related investments the income, covered by insurance from insurers with a claims-paying ability, exempt from regular federal and New York income tax and are rated Baa, BBB or better and having an average maturity of 15.98 years. It employs fundamental analysis with bottom-up stock picking approach to create its portfolio. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Standard & Poor's (S&P) New York Municipal Bond Index and the Standard & Poor's (S&P) Insured National Municipal Bond Index. It was formerly known as Nuveen New York AMT-Free Municipal Income Fund. Nuveen New York AMT-Free Quality Municipal Income Fund was formed on July 29, 2002 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Nuveen New York AMT-Free Quality Municipal Income Fund는 Nuveen Investments, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC 및 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC가 공동 관리합니다. 뉴욕 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 청구 지불 능력이 있고 정규 연방 및 뉴욕 소득세가 면제되고 Baa, BBB 이상 등급을 받고 평균 만기가 15.98년인 보험사의 보험으로 보장되는 저평가 지방 증권 및 기타 관련 투자에 투자합니다. 포트폴리오를 생성하기 위해 상향식 주식 선택 접근 방식을 갖춘 기본 분석을 사용합니다. 이 펀드는 Standard & Poor's(S&P) New York Municipal Bond Index 및 Standard & Poor's(S&P) Insured National Municipal Bond Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이전에는 Nuveen New York AMT-Free Municipal Income Fund로 알려졌습니다. Nuveen New York AMT-Free Quality Municipal Income Fund는 2002년 7월 29일에 결성되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
